work.$description: The work area: the space behind the prototype and beside the wiki. It's the only part of Fireside that changes with light and dark mode; the toolkit's chrome and components stay dark. Values from the toolkit's shell (designer-toolkit-code src/styles/shell.css, --work).

background.$description: Behind the prototype and the wiki. Light: pale blue-gray (oklch 0.93 0.012 217).

ink-quiet.$description: Quieter text on the work area: the wiki's body text and labels.

line.$description: Lines on the work area, like the wiki's dividers.

selected.$description: The selected page in the wiki's side nav: the primary color, darkened to read on light.
